sections.b: MapSoul is a platform connecting seekers with therapists and experts. Use of the platform is subject to these terms.
MapSoul is not responsible for content provided by practitioners, and is not a direct party to the therapeutic relationship.
We respect your privacy. For more information see our Privacy Policy.
We collect information you provide during signup and use of the platform, including name, email and questionnaire responses.
Information is used to improve user experience, tailor recommendations, and contact you regarding platform services.
We use secure infrastructure to store all data.
